data.summary: The recognizable hero raises an amber shield, visibly stops the approaching bus and turns back with a satisfied smile. Impact rings, cape motion and roadside dust are readable. The camera stays too close to show his feet or lower legs, leaving the planted-leg requirement unverified.

observations.text: An approaching bus grows in the street as the hero raises his palm and a shield forms. The camera looks from behind his shoulder; reference costume, cape and hair remain recognizable, but the lower body is outside the view.
The bus slows before the shield, with concentric impact rings and tire-area dust. The cape shifts behind the hero. No frame reveals the feet, so his ground contact cannot be confirmed.

The hero turns toward the lens, lowers his hand and smiles as the amber rings fade. The bus remains behind him without bodily collision or an extra hero. The final view is a tight torso portrait with mild facial/detail variation.
